subject: Post-call plan of action — trial success checklist & weekly momentum
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Green <taylor@cloudledger.io>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@cloudledger.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: next steps & proposed trial playbook

Hi Taylor / Aisha —

Thanks again for a great discovery call today. Short note to capture what we heard and propose a concrete plan to get a 4-week trial (POC) moving quickly. Goal: validate end-to-end latency, entity extraction accuracy on your invoices/shipments, and cost per 1k tokens for the production routing pattern.

Summary of needs we captured:
- Ingest pipeline: sample of 2,000 invoice/manifest records (anonymized)
- Success criteria: 95% extraction accuracy for key fields (invoice#, amount, vendor), 99th pctile latency < 350ms for chat/parse flows
- Security: SOC2 attestation + IP allowlist for VPC connector

Proposed POC timeline (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week): exchange NDA + get sample dataset + access plan
2) Week 1: onboarding + baseline run (validate infra and sample prep)
3) Week 2–3: iterate prompts, extraction rules, and quantization profile for cost testing
4) Week 4: acceptance run and handoff notes for production rollout

Owners we suggest:
- Redwood POC lead: Ben Carter (technical account lead) — will drive onboarding, test harness, and acceptance runs
- Redwood Solutions PM: Marissa Cole — will coordinate eval criteria and reporting cadence
- CloudLedger data lead: Aisha Patel — provide sample dataset and anonymization confirmation

Immediate asks for Tuesday kickoff: 
- Aisha: share a zipped sample (<=100MB) or a secure Drive link + brief schema note by Wed EOD
- Taylor: confirm the primary success metric (extraction precision vs recall) and whether there are any blocked IPs for our VPC connector

I attached a lightweight POC checklist and an owner table to this thread — helps expedite the kickoff.

If that aligns, Ben will set a 30-min onboarding slot for Thursday morning PT.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
-----

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: next steps & proposed trial playbook

Thanks Jasmine — this looks good and aligns with our needs. A few clarifications: 

- Dataset: we'll provide 2,000 rows but can start with a 250-row warmup set if that helps speed onboarding.
- Success metric: prioritize precision on invoice number and amount (so precision-weighted score), but we'd like recall above 85% as a hard floor.
- Security: we can start without VPC for the first week if it speeds setup — but we need IP allowlist details by Week 1 so we can move to VPC for Weeks 2–4.

Aisha will push the anonymized sample to a shared Drive by Wednesday 5pm PT. If your team can confirm a Thursday 9am PT slot for onboarding, we'll book calendars.

Also attaching a short internal doc with our KPIs for the pilot.

Cheers,
Taylor Green
Head of Integrations | CloudLedger

Taylor / Aisha —

Appreciate the quick replies. Per Jasmine's note and your confirmation, here's a proposed 30-min onboarding agenda and a short acceptance test plan we will use to measure progress.

Onboarding (Thu 9:00–9:30 PT):
- 9:00 — Introductions, goals, and dataset handoff confirmation (Jasmine + Aisha)
- 9:05 — Redwood infra & access (Ben) — share sandbox endpoint + sample run
- 9:12 — Parsing expectations & test harness (Marissa) — how we'll measure precision/recall
- 9:20 — Next steps and ownership recap (Jasmine)

Acceptance test plan (baseline + final run):
- Baseline: run 250-row warmup sample, capture token cost and latency distribution, annotate errors
- Iteration window: three prompt/regression cycles across Weeks 2–3; capture precision/recall per field after each cycle
- Final acceptance: 2,000-row run; acceptance if: invoice# precision >= 95% and amount precision >= 95% and recall >= 85% for key fields AND 99th pctile latency <= 350ms for targeted endpoints

Quick asks for tomorrow:
- Aisha: Drive link to warmup 250 rows + schema note (confirmed earlier)
- Taylor: any sample authorization process or PO required before we start (we can proceed on signatures if needed)

We'll publish a shared results sheet in the Drive folder so you can follow progress daily. I've attached the draft acceptance checklist for your review.

Best,
Ben Carter
